Variants.Content: Alamannic groups follow several chiefs. Makrian coordinates action while others retain families, followers and interests. Markets reward some groups while campaigning builds others’ reputation.
Alamanni comprise several chiefly groups. Followers retain family ties; decisions about guards and distant service affect common participation. Makrian’s common summons requires local cooperation.
Makrian’s common summons requires local cooperation. Coordination allocates actual supply and protection duties, not merely titles. Alamanni comprise several chiefly groups.
